posts.author: SpacemanSpiff
posts.text: Retail traders losses moderate in FY26 compared to FY25! — STT increased, tax still increased even if not in proportion. Maybe they will try again, who knows. Khoon chusenge … According to official data, the revenue generated through STT on F&O trades stood at Rs 27,695 crore in FY26, up from Rs 22,225 crore in FY25. In FY22, the annual revenue generated stood at Rs 6,634 crore. Only arbitrage or multi day people can trade futures now, useless for intraday.

posts.text: Retail traders losses moderate in FY26 compared to FY25! — Excerpt from the Moneycontrol article : A host of regulatory measures taken by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has curbed the net losses of individuals in the equity derivatives segment to Rs 91,685 crore in FY26 from Rs 1.12 lakh crore in FY25, the finance ministry informed the Parliament on August 11. However, the average per person loss, who traded in futures & options (F&O), stood at Rs 1.16 lakh in FY26, as compared to Rs 1.14 lakh in FY25.
